Editorial responsibilities

The editorial team oversees the following responsibilities:

  • Assess whether submitted manuscripts fall within the journal's aims and scope.
  • Coordinate independent peer review and evaluate reviewer recommendations.
  • Make editorial decisions based on scholarly merit and applicable publication policies.
  • Manage revisions, corrections and publication-related concerns.
  • Support transparency, research integrity and responsible scholarly communication.

Editorial independence

Editorial decisions should be based on the academic quality, relevance and integrity of a manuscript. Financial considerations, including any applicable publication charges, must not influence acceptance or rejection decisions.
